latitude.description: ↕️ The latitude of the location in degrees.

Connector.description: 🔌 A connector is a connection point (with a direction) of a type.

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the connector.
description.title: Description

mandatory.description: 💯 Whether the connector is mandatory. A mandatory connector must be connected in a design.
mandatory.title: Mandatory

interface.description: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 The optional interface of the connector. This allows to define explicit compatibility with other connectors.
interface.title: Interface

compatibleInterfaces.description: ✅ The optional other compatible interfaces of the connector. An empty list means this connector is compatible with all other connectors.
compatibleInterfaces.title: Compatibleinterfaces

point.description: ✖️ The connection point of the connector that is attracted to another connection point.

direction.description: ➡️ The direction of the connector. When another piece connects the direction of the other connector is flipped and then the pieces are aligned.

t.description: 💍 The parameter t [0,1[ where the connector will be shown on the ring of a piece in the diagram. It starts at 12 o`clock and turns clockwise.
t.title: T

Attribute.description: 📏 A attribute is a key value pair with an an optional definition.

value.description: 📏 The optional value [ text | url ] of the attribute. No value is equivalent to true.
value.title: Value

unit.description: 📏 The optional unit of the value of the attribute.
unit.title: Unit

Attribute.title: Attribute

description: 🧩 A type is a reusable element that can be connected with other types over connectors.

description.description: 💬 The optional human-readable description of the type.
description.title: Description

variant.description: 🔀 The optional variant of the type. No variant means the default variant.
variant.title: Variant

stock.description: 📦 The number of items in stock. 2147483647 (=2^31-1) means infinite stock.
stock.title: Stock

virtual.description: 👻 Whether the type is virtual. A virtual type is not physically present but is used in conjunction with other virtual types to form a larger physical type.
virtual.title: Virtual

unit.description: Ⓜ️ The length unit of the point and the direction of the connectors of the type.
unit.title: Unit
